relationships.subject: MMP9 Y262C variant
relationships.evidence_quote: Among the mutants, Y262C, P180L, G438A, and D434N were the most unstable, with average RMSD values of 0.754, 0.685, 0.507, and 0.513 nm, respectively.

relationships.subject: MMP9
relationships.evidence_quote: matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP9) playing a critical role in extracellular matrix remodelling and joint degradation

key_findings: In silico analysis found 9 damaging MMP9 catalytic-region nsSNPs (e.g. Y262C, P180L) predicted to destabilize the protein in MD simulations; Y262C removes a phosphorylation site.
